agent_unit.definition: complete Agent = model + harness + prompt/tools/runtime policy
agent_unit.pooling_policy: Agent/adapters are reported as complete configurations; adapter instability is not pooled away as model-only behavior.

primary_estimand.name: future_target_repo_verified_pass_rate_prediction_accuracy
primary_estimand.definition: How accurately a benchmark selection frozen at origin T predicts a complete Agent's later verified pass rate on the same target repository.
primary_estimand.future_outcome: verified pass rate on post-origin or held-out target-repo tasks
primary_estimand.selection_outcome: verified pass rate on selected benchmark tasks available at origin T

primary.formula: mean(abs(selection_pass_rate - future_pass_rate)) over scoreable preregistered slices
primary.missing_cell_policy: Include a slice only when both selection and future sides have at least one scoreable cell; report non-scoreable counts separately.

secondary.formula: selection ranking agrees with future ranking when at least two Agents are scoreable in the same repo/window
share of slices where abs(selection_pass_rate - future_pass_rate) > 0.15

minimum_reporting: compare every candidate against simple baselines
report uncertainty or seed distribution where available

directional_traction_rule.label: directional_retrospective_traction
required_conditions: best promotable Barcarolle candidate has lower pass-rate MAE than the best simple baseline envelope
comparison uses frozen protocol and committed sanitized outcomes
diagnostic-only candidate is not treated as promotable
claim remains retrospective or underpowered unless future-preregistered gates pass

conditions: candidate MAE >= best simple baseline MAE
policy violation, non-scoreable rate, or timeout blocker prevents interpretation
only post-hoc diagnostic candidate beats baselines

required: true future holdout or strict preregistered rolling-origin design
repos, origins, task IDs, Agent configs, selectors, baselines, seeds, invalid-cell policy, score joins, and success thresholds frozen before outcome join
simple-baseline envelope beaten on primary MAE
rank agreement and recommendation regret do not contradict the primary result
scoreability, policy, endpoint, artifact-hygiene, and cost-accounting gates pass
